issues.title: Slugs have double hyphens and a hyphen at the end
issues.body:
The product page for "Hello, World! T-shirt" got the URL `/p/hello--world--t-shirt`, and "Webcam (HD)" got `/p/webcam--hd-`.

```python
>>> from huskyutils.text import slugify
>>> slugify("Webcam (HD)")
'webcam--hd-'
```

I expected `webcam-hd`.

issues.title: Shared payment loses a cent
issues.body:
Three friends split a $10.00 order and the charges were $3.33 each. That is $9.99, so one cent was never charged.

```python
>>> split_amount(1000, 3)
[333, 333, 333]
```

Suggested fix: add the leftover cents to the last person's share, which is how our point-of-sale system does it.

issues.title: word_count says "don't stop" is 2 words
issues.body:
"don't" is short for "do not", so "don't stop" should be 3 words. Our review length limit is too generous because of this.

```python
>>> word_count("don't stop")
2
```

issues.title: Delivery date skips over the weekend wrong
issues.body:
An order placed on Thursday 2026-11-05 with 3 business days of handling shows a delivery date of Monday 2026-11-09. Thursday plus 3 business days is Friday, Monday, Tuesday, so it should be Tuesday 2026-11-10.

```python
>>> add_business_days(date(2026, 11, 5), 3)
datetime.date(2026, 11, 9)
```

issues.title: Delivery windows overlap after merging
issues.body:
The checkout page shows overlapping delivery windows to customers.

```python
>>> merge_intervals([[8, 10], [1, 3], [2, 6]])
[[8, 10], [1, 6]]
```

I expected `[[1, 6], [8, 10]]`. It looks like it only works when the windows are already in order.

issues.title: A 1 kg package is charged $9 shipping
issues.body:
Our shipping table says packages up to and including 1 kg ship for $5.00. A package that weighs exactly 1 kg was charged $9.00.

```python
>>> shipping_cost(1)
900
```

issues.title: Free shipping for orders over $50
issues.body: Can we make shipping free when the order total is over $50? Most stores do this now and we think it would increase the average order size.

issues.title: Median on the sales dashboard is wrong for an even number of days
issues.body:
For a store open 4 days with daily sales 10, 20, 30, 40 the dashboard shows a median of 30. The median of four numbers is the average of the middle two, 25.

```python
>>> median([10, 20, 30, 40])
30
```

issues.title: 5 kg package should be in the heavy tier
issues.body:
A 5 kg package is charged $9.00 shipping. Packages of 5 kg are heavy and should cost $11.00 like the others above 5 kg.

```python
>>> shipping_cost(5)
900
```

issues.title: Product card description runs past the edge of the card
issues.body:
Product cards fit 30 characters of description, and we call `truncate(description, 30)`. The headphones card overflows:

```python
>>> s = truncate("Wireless noise-cancelling headphones with case", 30)
>>> s
'Wireless noise-cancelling head...'
>>> len(s)
33
```

The result should fit in 30 characters.
